pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, sub-polygonal dark regions with crenulated, leaf-like margins. Edge transitions exhibit soft pixel gradients rather than sharp boundaries. Relative spatial area is maximal on the upper neck and diminishes toward the lower flank where patches become more fragmented and stellate.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous lattice of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes predominantly show tri-radial and quadri-radial connectivity. Corridor pixel thickness is significantly greater on the neck and tapers on the posterior flank while maintaining high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude sawtooth silhouette along the dorsal neck and shoulder, defined by the projecting hair filaments of the mane against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear hypopigmented marks (scars) are visible on the mid-neck and central flank. A localized dark textural anomaly or lesion is present on the posterior rump area near the base of the tail.
